source_pair_counts.interpretation: 273 endpoint-specific pairs = 3 endpoints x 91 physical sample-plate pairs, not 273 independent compounds. 88 sample IDs map to 88 chemical IDs.

protocol.sampling: 77 balanced empirical assignments per PDO passage cluster, identical assignments across endpoints; shared joint affine and residual disturbance within each passage cluster
protocol.wave1: unchanged; all acquisition masks, stop calls, model parameters and thresholds reused from the original unblinding
protocol.coordinates: q = 1 - (native fold - NC_A) / (Methotrexate_A - NC_A); PDO lowest-dose reference mapped to q=1, zero viability to q=0
protocol.injection: wave2 only: q_B = a + g*q_A - g*empirical_bridge_delta; a=1-g-(NC_B-NC_A)/span_A; g=span_B/span_A
protocol.bridge: R[0] physical NC observations resampled without replacement from the paired MC plate; only acquired wave2 curves use a bridge; same draws in both arms

calibration.unbridged: identity; original bridge wells remain charged
calibration.reference_ratio: q_cal = q_B / observed_reference_B; nonpositive references are recorded as calibration failures
calibration.two_control_affine_diagnostic: (q_B-a)/g; exact native two-control medians; one additional R[0] control group per wave2 curve is charged

protocol.uncertainty: p025_p975 are empirical reassignment sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals; the original held-out CI remains unchanged

evidence_scope: Measured physical H9 cross-plate differences transported computationally to PDO observations. Actual new PDO wet experiments and wet wells saved = 0.
evidence_limits: Three PDO lines and eight passage clusters; curve-level binomial bounds assume exchangeable curves.
Physical S7 pairs lack acquisition timestamps and mix plate, passage, storage and assay-protocol effects.
The response-axis mapping and passage-shared residual are explicit transport assumptions. These sensitivity results are not measured PDO cross-plate outcomes.
One reference identifies one nuisance parameter. Simultaneous affine translation and gain require a second distinct control.
Source native NC has six replicates; v3 pays three and resamples three. The affine diagnostic uses source control medians and is optimistic about control estimation.
Activity calls certified or stopped in wave 1 remain fixed, so stability of misses is conditional on unchanged wave 1.
